title: Warranty - Furniture
text:
This warranty covers chairs and desks bought from our store, whether you ordered online or bought in person. Chairs and desks are covered for 10 years from the date of purchase against defects in materials and workmanship. The warranty is free, it comes with every chair and desk we sell, and you do not need to register it.

What the warranty covers

For chairs, the warranty covers the frame and the moving parts: the base, the casters, the gas cylinder, the tilt and height mechanisms, and the armrest and backrest adjustments. For desks, it covers the top, the frame, the legs, the drawers and the height-adjustment mechanism, together with the screws, bolts and fittings that hold the frame together. Coverage applies to normal use in a home or an office, by one person at a time, as described in the assembly and care guide that came with the piece.

What the warranty does not cover

The warranty does not cover normal wear and tear, cuts, scratches, stains, or damage from impacts and accidents. It does not cover fabric or leather covers, pieces used outdoors or in damp rooms such as bathrooms, pieces that were put together incorrectly or changed after purchase, or damage caused by moving them carelessly. It does not cover parts that wear out by design, such as the glides under chair legs, or pieces bought as floor samples. Damage caused by standing on a chair, or by putting a heavy load on a desk top, is not covered. It also does not cover costs or losses that follow from a defect, such as lost working time.

How to make a claim

To make a claim, contact our customer service team online or visit any of our stores with your proof of purchase. Describe the fault and, if you can, send photos of the defect and of the label under the seat or the desk top. Keep the piece until the claim is settled, because we may need to inspect it. Our team replies by email, usually within a few business days, and tells you whether the fault is covered and what happens next. If the fault makes the piece unsafe, stop using it straight away and say so in your claim, so that we can act quickly.

Repair or replacement

If the claim is accepted, we repair the faulty part or replace the piece with the same or a comparable one, and we choose which. Small parts are sent to you with instructions, while larger repairs are carried out by a technician who visits your home or office. If the piece is no longer sold, we offer a comparable piece instead. Any part that we replace is covered for the rest of the original warranty, not for a fresh period of its own. We pay for the parts and the labour of every covered repair.

Proof of purchase and transfer

Keep your proof of purchase for as long as the warranty runs, because it shows when the coverage started. If you bought online with your account, our team can find the sale there if the proof is lost. The warranty applies to the original buyer only, and it does not pass to another owner if the piece is sold or given away. If you move house, the warranty moves with you, as long as you still own the piece.
